subject: The confession I wasn't going to send about this month
preview_text: Our users just did something insane with Thesis Generator. The numbers are in and they're rewriting the rules.
body_paragraphs: Okay, I need to confess something. I almost didn't send this email. The data from this month scared me. It's the kind of thing that makes you question everything you thought you knew about how students write.

This month alone, Thesis Generator users produced over 2.1 million words of original, humanized text. The average paper completion time dropped from 8 hours to 47 minutes. And here's the part that made my jaw hit the floor: 94% of users who submitted papers generated with our 'Humanize AI' feature reported zero AI detection flags. Not just passing. Zero. The community is literally hacking the system while everyone else is panicking about Turnitin.

The secret weapon? It's not magic. It's the 'Humanize & Export' flow. Users are running their drafts through it, watching the AI score drop to undetectable levels, and exporting polished PDFs in under 90 seconds. They're not just writing faster. They're submitting with a confidence that's changing their entire semester.

Open the app right now. Tap 'Humanize & Export' on any draft. See your AI score vanish and get that submission-ready PDF. Do it before your next deadline hits. P.S. The users who do this 3 times before finals week have a 22% higher reported grade improvement. They're not smarter. They're just using the tool correctly.
